jobs.title: Dynamic Part-Time Evening Security Pro - Shopping Center
jobs.description:
United Protective Services is seeking a reliable Part-Time Security Officer for a neighborhood shopping center in Houston, TX. This evening shift role emphasizes visible security presence and customer service.

You will patrol exterior areas, monitor for suspicious activity, and report incidents to the Client Service Manager. The ideal candidate holds a Texas security license or can obtain one, and communicates professionally with tenants and guests.
